summary_raw: Key risks: US-Iran military tensions (Strait of Hormuz threats), US intervention in Venezuela, NATO/Greenland posture, ongoing tariff uncertainty. IMF: short-lived Middle East conflict scenario still sees 3.1% global growth and 4.4% headline inflation. Middle East conflict has raised oil prices ~19%, weighing on sentiment.
